notes:
Two characters, two voices.

When casting picked voices for two people talking, it could land on two that sound the same — near-identical in pitch, so it came across as one voice doing both parts. It now picks voices far enough apart to tell apart.

Shouted names are no longer swallowed: "GON!", "BAN!", "KIRA!" were being treated as sound effects and read as silence.

And a line you correct now stays corrected even when the source serves the page from a different address.
